entities.name: On-site Drawings
entities.description: ArcSite's mobile drawing tool for to-scale site plans and floor plans on a tablet or phone, with no CAD training required. Drawings can start by hand, from an AR scan, a satellite map, or an imported PDF, work offline, and feed the takeoff and proposal directly.
